name: query
description: Read entities from the KB with exact filters, or ask typed fact questions. Use for lookup by id, type, tags or sourceFile, and for precise questions about modeled facts: predicate facts by name with named arguments (predicate + where), property facts of a subject (subjectKey + propertyKey), or the catalog of facts of one kind (factKind; 'predicate_schema' lists the predicates you can ask about with their argument names and constants). Typed answers return matching fact rows plus factQuery: the schema used, distinct counts, values that do exist when nothing matched, warnings about the question and the next call to make. Read-only. Tags filter by metadata tags only, not entity IDs.

options.description: JSON input file (use - for stdin)

Output format: json|table

name: search
description: Ask the KB a question or search it. Default intent-v1 ranking accepts questions, host-agent semantic facets and changed-code source locations, returns evidence, abstains below its confidence threshold and adds an answer layer: the current requirements that govern the topic, what must stay true (linked facts), why (ADRs) and what verifies it (scenarios, tests). A weak answer may add queryAnalysis.hints from a search-hints plugin: requirements the question may mean, to re-ask with. Use before changing behavior, then kb_query for exact follow-up. No mutation side effects.

name: status
description: Report current branch, KB snapshot, freshness metadata, schema status, and a typed kibi.migration-plan.v2 action graph. Call it first to orient on a branch or after a failed call; use kb_check for validation findings and kb_coverage for proof status. Read-only status inspection with no mutation side effects; damaged stores are diagnosed without starting the engine.
